I wrote my first line of code at 14. It started with spending a few hours teaching a robot named Karel to navigate a screen, but quickly escalated to thousands of hours where I built an AI that beat me at board games, trained a neural net in high school, and even launched a Twitter clone on crypto rails (it raised a bit of funding before it shut it down).

I studied computer science for eight years and spent every college summer in the Bay Area, eventually moving to San Francisco right after graduation. For as long as I can remember, it’s been clear to me that few things shape the world more profoundly than technology.

Venture has always felt like a dream job. I love meeting exceptional founders, wherever they are, and supporting them on the journey of solving ambitious problems. I helped launch our London office in 2023, and took nearly 150 flights during that time to connect with entrepreneurs around the globe.

I'm a generalist at heart. I believe technology can reshape every aspect of society, and I love hearing the creative solutions founders come up with to impact the world in ways I could never have imagined on my own.
